about: The Workbench icons of the ShadowPong drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/shadowpong.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: a black court with a grey bar along its top, a white paddle at each side and a white square ball with its grey shadow) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/shadowpong.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. ShadowPong-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, ShadowPong.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's ShadowPong.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for README-ShadowPong.txt and Licences.txt; Data.info is the Data drawer's icon.
